The '''''Dismay''''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The ''Dismay''{{'s}} [[Unidentified Imperial captain (Dismay)|captain]] intended to [[Marriage/Legends|marry]] [[Praleena Pring]], daughter of Imperial [[Consul-General]] [[Dandamont Pring]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], but Praleena and her [[Unidentified Imperial defector|lover]] instead defected to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].
